verdicts.title: Narrating/history comments in spawn code
verdicts.note: Core confirmed: Spawn.tsx 1171 comment lines; 'evener/host/request proxy ... not in this branch' at Spawn.tsx:1042, 1495 and 2330 sits beside live hostRequest calls (false); Spawn.tsx:161 cites DEFAULT_EFFORT_LEVELS which exists nowhere in non-test code (StatusRow uses sessionEffortLevels); spawn.js cited 2x in Spawn.tsx, 7x in spawnDefaults.ts, no spawn.js exists; the friendlyLaunchErrorMessage comment is pasted verbatim at 2599 and 2651; startThread.ts/preflight.ts narrate T1/T2. Marker count measured 57+18 vs claimed 64+22. Size claim of -1500 comment lines is impossible (only 1171 comment lines in Spawn.tsx, much of it genuine invariants).
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Delete history/round/kata/floor/spawn.js/T1-T2 narration and the false 'absent from this branch' and DEFAULT_EFFORT_LEVELS comments; dedupe the pasted friendlyLaunchErrorMessage comment (goes away with a shared launch wrapper, see -5). Keep invariants of 1-3 sentences. Realistic size about -500 to -700 comment lines. Do per file before extraction work.

verdicts.title: Spawn re-implements host-routed path/launch RPCs launchConfigStoreForHost provides
verdicts.note: Spawn.tsx:1322 (paths/complete), 1343 (path/validate), 1372/2648 -> preflight.createDir (dirs/create), 1450 (launch/resolve) use raw hostRequest with a hand-written `?? []`. Settings project.tsx:68-80 uses launchConfigStoreForHost(host).getState(); appwire-client launchConfig.ts:66-77 already implements validatePath, createDirectory, completePaths (with the same `resp.data ?? []`) and resolve. createDir has a test file (preflight.test.ts) and two callers. evener/projects/recent (1314) has no store equivalent so it stays. Severity lowered: about five small wrappers, duplication is real but not a drift-causing high.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Bind validatePath/createDirectory/complete/resolveConfig to launchConfigStoreForHost(submittedSource); keep listRecents on hostRequest; keep the activeHostRef stale-answer loop wrapping the store call; delete preflight.createDir and its test cases (preflightDir stays unless also moved). Verify the store's goneLaunchConfigStore refusal (throws for an unregistered host) against Spawn's stale-source path before landing.

verdicts.title: Seven hand-rolled host-changed refs and reset effects
verdicts.note: All seven refs exist: providerDialogHostRef 435, createDialogHostRef 603, modelHostRef 578/1691, cwdHostRef+cwdIssuanceRef+cwdCancelledRef 640-681, activeHostRef 1336, pathValidationTarget 1391, catalogHostRef 1513/1555. verdicts.title: Slash-completion state machine copied from Composer and drifted
verdicts.note: Duplication confirmed: commitSlashCompletion Spawn.tsx:1014-1031 vs Composer.tsx:833-857 and the ArrowUp/Down/Tab/Enter/Escape blocks. But the headline drift claim is REFUTED: SkillEditor.tsx insertAtom ends with view.focus() (SkillEditor.tsx:228), so insertSkill/insertCommand already focus the editor in Spawn; Composer's extra editorRef.current?.focus() after insertSkill is redundant, not a missing behavior. Spawn's keymap also differs deliberately (plain Enter commits, Mod+Enter submits), documented in its comment. Severity high -> medium.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Extract a shared useSlashCompletion beside SlashCompletionMenu with commitOnPlainEnter option; no red-first focus test (no bug). Behavior-preserving, guarded by both panes' existing slash tests. Coordinate with the Composer owner.

verdicts.title: usePluginPreview and useSpawnSlashCatalog near-duplicate hooks
verdicts.note: Structure duplication confirmed (110 vs 144 lines, same result/requestKey/lastResponse/debounce/derived-first-render shape). The claimed drift 'client-swap fix exists in one hook only' is wrong: usePluginPreview's effect has client in its deps and an `active` flag cleared in cleanup (usePluginPreview.ts:66,70-75,92-95), which already discards a swapped client's late response; the slash hook's clientGenerationRef is the redundant/extra guard. Real drift: usePluginPreview writes launchOverridesRef during render (line 40) whereas the slash hook assigns in an effect; the disabled state differs (slash returns ready-empty).
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: One useScopedHostRead<T> parameterized by method/params/disabledState; keep the `active` cleanup flag (simpler than generation); no client-swap red test needed for plugin path, add one only as a regression pin. Merge test files cautiously (they cover different contracts).

verdicts.title: AdvancedOptions is a second launch-config form drifted from settings
verdicts.note: Confirmed: maxRounds -1/0 'unlimited' in AdvancedOptions.tsx:318-322 and launchSchema.ts:~230; resolvedValue duplicated at AdvancedOptions.tsx:278 and LaunchConfigForm.tsx:110; MCP add syntax diverges (AdvancedOptions.tsx:716-731 `name=command args` split on /\s+/ vs collectionFields.tsx:417 parseMcpServerEntry with shell-style quoting). Correction: the three pathKind mappers are NOT equivalent (AdvancedOptions returns null for non-browsable, collectionFields.tsx:131 falls back to 'dir', fields.tsx:82 returns undefined), so a single browsablePathKind needs a per-caller fallback. Some logic is already shared (validatePathListAdd). The -450 LOC claim is optimistic. Severity high -> medium; the MCP syntax divergence is the user-visible part.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: PR A: move input default placeholder/boolean label text onto the shared resolvedDefaultLabel (keep the 60-char clip in one place) and share resolvedValue; keep distinct pathKind fallbacks explicit. PR B: have AdvancedOptions render settings' PathListField/ModelListField/EnvMapField/McpServerListField from launchShared; MCP syntax unification is a user-visible change that needs Jesse's decision first.

verdicts.title: Model list has three uncoordinated consumers plus catalog stamp state machine
verdicts.note: Three model/list call sites confirmed: Spawn.tsx:1175 (scoped harness+cwd, cached), 1719 (uncached {harness:'evener'}), useProviderSetup.ts:83 ({} for keyless availability). But they ask different questions with different params, so they are not duplicate RPCs of the same request; the comment at 1192 only claims the model controls share the scoped promise. The complexity (ownership via completionOwned, stamp states) is real but is a redesign, not a cleanup. Severity medium -> low.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Do not merge requests. Option: route all three through one cached per-(host,params) model/list helper so identical params dedupe, after -1 extraction; document the completionOwned protocol once.

verdicts.title: Desktop and phone UIs both mounted; hand-built sheets; raw controls
verdicts.note: Confirmed: Spawn.tsx:3125-3170 desktop plugin tree and mobile tree (data-testid spawn-mobile-config) both rendered, .mobileConfig {display:none} in spawn.module.css:205; raw controls: Spawn.tsx:2772 <button>, 2998 <select>, 3085 <input type=file hidden>, AdvancedOptions.tsx:219, MobileSettingRows.tsx:100,137 (6). Spawn.tsx:233 comment documents that the Select widget lacks capability, so some raw use is a known widget gap, and AGENTS.md says do not add widgets without asking. 'Render one tree via useIsMobile' is a design/behavior change (resize flicker, spawnguard CSS cases) not a plain cleanup. Severity medium -> low.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: First do the safe parts: one pluginSummaryText helper; replace raw button/file-input where Button exists. List the Select/RadioGroup capability gaps for Jesse. Single-tree rendering only after discussing with Jesse and running spawnguard.

verdicts.title: Shared derivations in the pane: effort ladder and access-mode table
verdicts.note: Access-mode table confirmed in three places with differing wording: accessMode.ts:14-19 (+descriptions 52-70), mobile launchSetup.ts:120-130 ACCESS_LEVELS, mobile sessionFacts.ts:78-83 ACCESS_MODES. sandboxForAccessMode/accessModeForSandbox are web-only. Effort ladder claim is wrong as stated: shared sessionEffortLevels returns [] when supportsReasoning is undefined, while Spawn's catalogEffortLevels (Spawn.tsx:190-207) deliberately returns null for 'hub cannot say' and substitutes the fallback ladder, so the semantics differ and cannot be replaced by sessionEffortLevels without a behavior change. Spawn.tsx:161 comment also names a nonexistent DEFAULT_EFFORT_LEVELS.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Move only the access-mode table (value, sandbox, label, description) and mapping functions to appwire-client/typescript with unit tests; mobile adopts later. Leave the effort ladder, or add a shared helper that models the unknown (null) case explicitly. Update README and S16 row.

verdicts.title: transcript pane type is a job-log pane plus legacy session shim
verdicts.note: Identity confusion confirmed (Transcript.tsx:1-79 header, 30 transcript-type checks counted). But the fix plan overlooks that a restore-time migration already exists (workspace.ts:360-372 and migrateLegacyLayout 378+ retype non-job transcript panes to session and lift parentRef). The runtime recovery effect (Transcript.tsx:62-70) additionally covers a cascade Return that retypes a pane back to a legacy source, so deleting it needs proof that path is gone. Removing compat needs Jesse's approval per rules. Renaming the persisted pane type 'transcript' would invalidate saved layouts. Severity medium -> low.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Ask Jesse first. If approved: confirm the cascade-Return retype path no longer yields transcript-typed session panes, then delete the Transcript.tsx effect and zoom 'transcript' source acceptance (intent.ts:86-88) while keeping migrateLegacyLayout; defer any pane-type rename.
